DHS watchdog: Immigrants held in outdoor cages the size of phone booths at ‘Alligator Alcatraz'
results.description: Some immigrant detainees held at Florida’s now-shuttered “Alligator Alcatraz” were confined for up to two hours inside outdoor cages only slightly larger than a telephone booth, according to a new report by the Department of Homeland Security’s inspector general.
